questions.prompt: Which signal means the seat stops and waits for the operator's answer?

choices.why: escalate asks for attention while the seat keeps working.
blocked says the work is entirely blocked: stop and wait for the answer.
feedback says work is ready to review; the seat is not blocked.
A preamble is a thought bubble, not a signal.

questions.prompt: How many one-click replies can a signal suggest with --suggest?

choices.why: At most two suggestions, shown ahead of the operator's quick replies.

questions.prompt: Does a seat need a line to raise a signal?

choices.text: Yes, a messages line to the operator
choices.why: Lines join seats to seats; signals go to the operator with no line.

choices.text: No: any seat raises its own signals
choices.why: Signals are seat-local: no edge and no port, and they stay open even on a paused canvas.
Every signal kind is raised the same way.
